svg.text: QBM-05 · TCA cycle and the Fe/S-dependent steps
Drawn as an actual cycle, so a lesion at aconitase or succinate dehydrogenase throttles flux around the loop rather

g.title: Acetyl-CoA tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context
Oxaloacetate tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context
Malate dehydrogenase (MMDH1) tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT1G53240
Citrate synthase (CSY4) tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT2G44350
Citrate tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context

Aconitase (ACO1/2/3) tier T3 (inferred) quantum class: iron_sulfur_4Fe4S nuclei: 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT4G35830, AT4G26970, AT2G05710 rationale: The review nominates aconitase as the sentinel of Fe/S integrity, and the biochemistry supports it: the exposed cluster iron makes aconitase the first TCA activity to fall under oxidative stress, so it reports cluster damage before anything else does.
caveat: Precisely because aconitase responds to any oxidative insult, a change under NNMF would NOT by itself implicate a magnetic mechanism. It is a sensitive readout and a poor discriminator; it needs a paired ROS-independent control.
Isocitrate tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context
Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH1, IDH2) tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT4G35260, AT2G17130

Lipoyl synthase (LIP1) tier T3 (inferred) quantum class: iron_sulfur_4Fe4S, radical_pair_donor nuclei: 57Fe, 33S, 1H AGI: AT2G20860 rationale: A radical-SAM enzyme generating a 5'-deoxyadenosyl radical from a [4Fe-4S] cluster — genuine organic radical chemistry on an iron-sulfur centre, which is the tightest coupling of the review's two proposed mechanisms found anywhere in primary metabolism. Its product lipoylates pyruvate dehydrogenase and the 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex, so a defect propagates straight into TCA flux.
caveat: The radical is generated inside the active site and quenched within one turnover; whether a spin-correlated pair with a long enough lifetime to be field-sensitive ever forms is untested.

Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) tier T3 (inferred) quantum class: flavin_semiquinone, iron_sulfur_2Fe2S, iron_sulfur_4Fe4S, iron_sulfur_3Fe4S, ros_leak_site nuclei: 1H, 14N, 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT5G66760, AT3G27380, AT5G40650, AT5G09600, AT2G46505 rationale: Carries all three cluster types plus a covalent flavin, and sits at the junction the review nominates as the bottleneck — a change here propagates into both TCA flux and respiratory electron flow.
Fumarase (FUM1) tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT2G47510
NADH / NAD+ tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context

Mitochondrial superoxide / H2O2 tier T2 (reported) quantum class: ros_leak_site AGI: AT3G10920 Parmagnani2022: Near-null magnetic field exposure alters ROS-associated transcriptomic and metabolomic programmes in Arabidopsis. [10.3390/biom12121824] Farooq2021: Reactive oxygen species and mitochondria jointly regulate seed germination, establishing the route from mitochondrial ROS to a developmental outcome. [10.3389/fpls.2021.781734] rationale: Not a magnetosensitive mechanism itself — it is the amplifier. A field effect too small to measure as a rate change can still register here, because ROS signalling is threshold-like.

svg.text: The review's Figure 4 renders this as a linear chain from glucose to oxaloacetate with no OAA-to-citrate closure, which the
draft's own margin note flags. The closure matters: it is what shows that the two Fe/S-dependent steps throttle flux around the
whole loop instead of interrupting a line. Aconitase and succinate dehydrogenase are the review's sentinel nodes and are
annotated once on QBM-01, referenced here rather than re-declared, so one entity cannot carry different evidence on two
maps. The citrate-to-isocitrate ratio is the most direct available in-vivo proxy for Fe/S cluster integrity and is worth measuring in
any near-null-field metabolomics experiment. Note that plant mitochondrial fumarase is a class-II enzyme with no Fe/S cluster,
unlike the class-I bacterial form it is sometimes confused with. Derived from: Figure 4 of Porterfield & Barker, "Plant Responses
to Near-Null Magnetic Fields" — redrawn as a closed cycle, expanded to gene level and bound to Arabidopsis loci. Node counts
by evidence tier: T2=1, T3=3, T4=9. Schematic topology only — no quantitative value is encoded in this base map; numbers
appear only when measured data is projected onto it.
